Method of Attack: Uses seven NSA tools including ETERNALBLUE, ETERNALCHAMPION, ETERNALROMANCE, ETERNALSYNERGY for SMB exploits, SMBTOUCH and ARCHITOUCH for SMB reconnaissance, and DOUBLEPULSAR for propagation
Two-stage installation process with delayed second stage
Downloads Tor client and beacons C&C server on .onion domain
After 24 hours delay, downloads second stage malware (shadowbrokers.zip) containing NSA SMB-centric exploits
Rapid IP scanning and attempts to connect to random IP addresses
Controls infected computers via C&C server commands
Leverages DOUBLEPULSAR implant as backdoor for further malware delivery
Impacted Systems: Computers with SMB ports exposed online, vulnerable SMB services
Indicators of Compromise: shadowbrokers.zip archive containing NSA SMB-centric exploits
C&C server located on a .onion domain on the Dark Web
Use of NSA tools: ETERNALBLUE, ETERNALCHAMPION, ETERNALROMANCE, ETERNALSYNERGY, SMBTOUCH, ARCHITOUCH, DOUBLEPULSAR
